name: Zainab Holm
headline: Software Developer
summary: Software developer who has built and supported customer-facing and internal products across web application teams. Comfortable working across implementation, integration, and delivery, with a focus on clear collaboration and reliable outcomes. Brings steady ownership from junior development through full product delivery.

roles.title: Junior Software Engineer
bullets: Built interface features in JavaScript and TypeScript, connecting them to REST APIs and fixing issues before release.
Updated existing screens and data flows, improving reliability for a 15% drop in recurring support tickets.
Worked with the product team to turn feedback into small, maintainable changes and clearer application behavior.

roles.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Implemented account and session flows with OAuth, helping secure access for a customer portal used by over 8,000 users.
Wrote SQL queries to support reporting and operational views, reducing manual lookups by 40%.
Reviewed edge cases with designers and analysts to keep data handling accurate across the application.

roles.title: Software Developer
bullets: Delivered backend services in Go and Node.js using Express and NestJS, with GraphQL endpoints for a multi-team product line.
Ran an Agile delivery cadence, breaking work into small increments and keeping priorities aligned across 3 squads.
Improved request handling and service reliability by tightening server logic and trimming slow paths in the backend.
Partnered with testers and product owners to refine integration points and ship changes with fewer rework cycles.
Built reusable application modules that simplified feature delivery and supported a faster release flow for internal teams.
